comment: A dollar more for ad-free, offline and unlimited skips is still a steal to me. I use it every single day so I am not going anywhere. I just wish the free tier was not treated so badly.

Price is not my issue at all. I already cancelled and the renewal pop up still shows up every time I open the app. Cleared cache, reinstalled, nothing works. It started after an update and it is driving me nuts because I just want to pause and skip.
Price is not what bugs me, the forced new layout is. I rolled back to an older build and turned off auto updates. I will cancel the day they force that layout on me. I just want to listen to music.

The enhance feature is what kills me, it mixes recommended songs into my own playlists and I cannot even tell which ones I already like anymore. I already cancelled Premium over this stuff, but years of playlist work are hard to walk away from. Skiley and stats.fm help a bit.

Price is not really what I am tracking, I am more annoyed that album radio got removed. Still, Spotify is the most feature-rich thing I have tried and radio plus Discover Weekly keep me on it. Anyone know a workaround for album radio?

The price is fine, I would still pay it for ad-free music and skipping ads in podcasts when I am driving. But the home screen is a podcast and TikTok mess and I keep hunting for the music filter. If it does not get fixed I will cancel again, I already did once over this.

Great, paying more for ad-free music while podcast ads still play for Premium users. Podcasts are shoved down my throat on the home screen and I cannot filter them out. I will keep it for the music and device integration, but this is greedy as hell.

Fine, a dollar. I still get more value from Premium than from all my other subscriptions combined and I would never go back to free. My complaint is the pop up suggestions and the UI changes, not the price. They should spend that money on fixing the app though.

The price bump does not bother me, what bothers me is artists still get fractions of a cent per stream while Spotify keeps raising prices. If they want more of my money they should pay artists more. I am mostly on Apple Music now but I kept Spotify out of habit.

The price is still low for the library and Discover Weekly, and I think Spotify's algorithm still beats Apple Music. My problem is the repetition and the new UI hiding discovery playlists, not the price. A buck more is not going to make me switch.

The price is whatever, I think Premium is worth it. But the home screen looks like TikTok with huge blocks of suggestions and I am cancelling my membership if they do not revert it. Apple Music or stoop to Tidal, I am done with this layout.

A buck more hurts less than I expected. I listen for hours a day so it is still worth it to me. I tried Apple Music but Spotify Connect and collaborative playlists keep me here. The student plan probably goes up too though, which sucks.

So they are charging more and it is still 320 kbps, while Tidal and Apple Music give lossless for similar money. For portable listening 320 is fine for me, but paying more for the same thing is a hard sell. I want to see how the hi-fi stuff goes before deciding anything.

I do not care about the price, I care that I pay for Premium and still do not get a true random shuffle. It keeps replaying the same top songs, and on CarPlay it only plays liked songs. I still love the service overall but I will be seriously looking at Apple Music if this does not change.

Premium is already out of my budget so this changes nothing for me. I will keep using the free version with ads and shuffle. Maybe if I can afford it someday I will think about it, but for now it is the same deal.

I do not even care about the price, the music tab is still the same awful card layout instead of album tiles. I already cancelled Premium over this redesign and if they do not turn it back I am switching to Apple Music for good.

Nickel and dime, money grubbing. They took the heart button out of playlists and now want a monthly add-on to get it back. I cannot add the same song twice and every like goes into Liked Songs first. I am sticking around for the folders but this is stupid and unnecessary.

The price is whatever honestly, but the UI changes keep burying my library and the AI DJ clutter makes it worse. The recommendations are the only reason I stay. YouTube Music is a great deal with a strong app and I am close to going there.

The student plan going up a dollar sucks, I am a broke student and five bucks was the thing I was clinging to. The Hulu bundle still makes it a steal so I will probably stay. Losing Showtime still annoys me though.

A buck is not going to change much for me, I have been paying since 2018 and the features I like are worth the setup effort. I am more annoyed that they keep removing stuff like Spotlight without warning. Still hoping the new features reach my account soon.

A dollar more is fine by me, the music is absurdly cheap for what you get. My issue is artists still get almost nothing per stream, so if they want more of my money they should pay the artists more. I would happily pay more if that is where it goes.

Same price increase but still no lossless or HiFi tier, while Tidal and Qobuz already give lossless for similar money. I keep Spotify for Connect and Discover Weekly, but I am paying for two services now and this makes it worse. The UI changes do not help either.

Price is not my thing, I just want the app to work. Downloads broke after an update and support gave me nothing, and auto updates keep bringing the broken version back. I rolled back and reinstalled and it is still broken. If they cannot fix the bugs I would not pay more for this.

A buck is nothing, Premium is still bang for the buck for me since I use it every day for no ads and skips. My issue is ads getting heavier and perks getting pulled without a price change, which makes this hike sour. I am still going to keep paying.

The family plan is still pretty cheap per person so I am not too bothered. What I care about is that they do not force me onto a duo or family plan I do not need. Splitting it with the household works great for us, so we will keep paying.

A dollar is less than an hour of my pay and I cannot live without no ads, so I am not cancelling over this. My real annoyance is the trial stuff and cancelling still keeps nagging me to renew. Premium is the one subscription I never cancel.

Price is not my beef, it is the liked song hearts being gone from album and track lists. I am keeping Daily Mix for now but if the hearts do not come back I will unsubscribe again. Apple Music is still sitting there as an option.

Another price hike with no lossless or Spatial Audio, which is what I would expect Premium to include by now. Apple Music sounds and looks better to me but Spotify Connect and Android Auto keep me here. I will probably stay for now but this is a reason to go back to Apple.
